annotations.title: Get a flashcard and its review position

description: Get one flashcard and exactly where it sits in its spaced-repetition cycle: stage, step (consecutive successful recalls), interval, ease, next due date, lapses, its position in the deck's study queue (queue_position of queue_size), and its last 10 reviews. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

card_id.description: Card id — from list_memo_cards or get_memo_study_queue.

timezone.description: The user's IANA timezone, e.g. "Europe/Berlin" or "Asia/Tokyo". Decides what "due today" and "which day" mean. Defaults to UTC — pass it whenever you know it.

name: get_memo_card
